phrase.en: The train is late. How long do we have to wait at the station?
phrase.ru: Поезд опаздывает. Сколько нам ждать на вокзале?
phrase.es: El tren llega tarde. ¿Cuánto tenemos que esperar en la estación?

text.ru: How long…? — «как долго». have to — нужно: we have to wait. Late — «поздно/опоздавший»: The train is late.
text.en: How long…? asks about duration. Have to expresses necessity: we have to wait. Late means "after the expected time".
text.es: How long…? have to = tener que. Late = tarde.

examples.en: We have to wait for another train.

exercises.en: We have to ___ for two hours.
The train arrived half an hour ___ .
exercises.ru: Поезд прибыл с опозданием на полчаса.

exercises.en: We waited at the station for an hour.
